subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact summary after final delivery, and the requested behavior adds public config plus a new visible message lifecycle that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Add default-off full retention
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that preserves the completed progress draft/checklist while leaving the current compact-summary behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep compact summary only
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep current main's final answer plus one-line activity digest model.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track this under a broader cross-channel progress-card API so checklist state and retention semantics do not drift by channel.

recommendation.title: Add default-off full retention
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that preserves the completed progress draft/checklist while leaving the current compact-summary behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has the most targeted recent history on the Telegram collapse-bar fallback path this option would extend.
